html:
In a world that constantly pulls us outward, many of us are quietly holding tension deep within — not in the shoulders or the mind, but in the belly. Tightness. Bloating. Emotional heaviness. A sense of being “off” without knowing why. What if your body isn’t malfunctioning… but simply asking to be listened to?

This is where Chi Nei Tsang comes in.

What Is Chi Nei Tsang?

Chi Nei Tsang is an ancient Taoist abdominal healing practice that works directly with the organs, breath, and nervous system. Rooted in the same tradition as Qi Gong, this practice focuses on the belly — often referred to as the body’s emotional and energetic center.

Through gentle, intentional touch, Chi Nei Tsang supports the release of tension stored deep within the abdomen, helping restore a natural sense of flow in the body.

Why the Belly Matters More Than You Think

Modern research increasingly supports what ancient traditions have always known: The gut is deeply connected to the brain and nervous system.

Often called the “second brain,” the gut plays a key role in:

  • Emotional regulation
  • Stress response
  • Digestion and overall vitality

When stress accumulates, the body doesn’t just “think” it — it holds it. And for many people, that holding happens in the belly.

The Benefits of Chi Nei Tsang

While research on Chi Nei Tsang specifically is still emerging, studies on related Taoist practices like Qi Gong show meaningful benefits for both physical and emotional well-being.

Through this lens, Chi Nei Tsang may support:

  • Nervous system regulation:
    Encouraging the body to shift into a parasympathetic (rest-and-digest) state
  • Emotional release:
    Helping unwind stored tension linked to stress, anxiety, or past experiences
  • Digestive support:
    Stimulating circulation and awareness in the abdominal organs
  • Energy flow & vitality:
    Reducing stagnation and restoring a sense of internal movement
  • Deep relaxation:
    Creating space for the body to reset and recalibrate

What Happens During a Session?

A Chi Nei Tsang session is slow, intuitive, and deeply grounding. You’ll be guided to connect with your breath as gentle abdominal work begins — not forceful, but listening. Each session is unique.

Some people experience:

  • A sense of lightness afterward
  • Emotional release
  • Deep relaxation
  • Improved connection to their body
  • Supportive relief from indigestion, bloating, constipation, and overall digestive discomfort

There is nothing to “perform” or “achieve.” It’s a process of returning.

Why Experience Chi Nei Tsang in Bali?

Bali offers something rare — an environment that naturally supports slowing down. Surrounded by nature, warmth, and intentional living, your body is already more open to receiving.

At Bali Bliss, Chi Nei Tsang is not offered as a quick treatment, but as part of a guided reset.

Not luxury.
Not escape.
But a return to yourself.

A Gentle Invitation

If you’ve been feeling:

  • Disconnected from your body
  • Overwhelmed without a clear reason
  • Tense in your belly or digestion

This may be your body asking for a different kind of support.

Not more doing. But deeper listening.

Chi Nei Tsang sessions are offered as private, one-on-one experiences in Ubud, Bali.

Reach out to schedule your session and experience this deeply restorative form of bodywork.
